components.task_name: DFT - Extract, Cleanse, Validate, Load claims
components.description: Routes rows failing business rules to error output. Rules: paid_amount >= 0.00 AND reserve_amount >= 0.00 AND recovery_amount >= 0.00 | ABS(incurred_amount - calculated_incurred_amount) <= 1.00 (incurred = paid + reserve - recovery) | loss_date <= reported_date AND reported_date <= claim_date (BR-12 lifecycle chronology) | claim_status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','ON_HOLD','CLOSED','REJECTED')

properties.Conditions: paid_amount >= 0.00 AND reserve_amount >= 0.00 AND recovery_amount >= 0.00 | ABS(incurred_amount - calculated_incurred_amount) <= 1.00 (incurred = paid + reserve - recovery) | loss_date <= reported_date AND reported_date <= claim_date (BR-12 lifecycle chronology) | claim_status IN ('OPEN','IN_PROGRESS','ON_HOLD','CLOSED','REJECTED')

components.component_name: AGG - Claims Incurred Summary by Policy (BR-09 pre-aggregation)
components.description: Pre-aggregates incurred/paid/reserve/recovery per policy_id BEFORE any KPI join, preventing duplicate premium totals when joined downstream.

properties.Aggregates: SUM(paid_amount), SUM(reserve_amount), SUM(recovery_amount), SUM(incurred_amount), COUNT(claim_id) AS claim_count
